title: Furg Citadel
geometryBasis: The mapped ridge enclosure controls overall width, bend order and position. Independent terrain gives the east-to-west rise. The public-domain village view controls the recognizable south curtain and western compound profile.
sectionBasis: The official visitor inventory identifies the low east gate, middle zone and highest western compound, with rounded earthen masonry towers and successive repairs. Proportions of individual towers and incomplete masonry are estimated against the mapped width and the cleared ground view.
limitations: The model represents the hilltop structure’s present exterior character. Internal rooms, underground features and exact individual interior ruins have no verified geometric record here.
Overall plan and terrain follow the native map and elevation. Tower positions between vertices, wall heights, unseen exterior detail and repair phases use conservative estimates.
